correctness.rationale: The determinant identity is integral. The standalone code verifies critical symbolic and point-count inputs.

value.rationale: The classical Cayley Hessian is a natural rank-20 CM K3. Its smallest good inert-prime special fiber at five has explicitly established rational nodes and a maximal quadratic-extension zeta; the exact Frobenius sign distribution and point count of this model are natural arithmetic invariants, not an arbitrary parameter slice. This distinguishes it from a related, inequivalent characteristic-five Sylvester Hessian.
